facts: January 2026 reporting gives about 39000 premises unable to access decent broadband from fixed line or fixed wireless access
The affordable-decent-broadband estimate falls to about 4000 after lower-priced Starlink availability in selected areas
About 7000 additional commercial premises may meet the technical condition but were excluded from the affordable estimate because some may already use connectivity such as leased lines
official_source_candidates.guard: Keep fixed/FWA technical availability, satellite affordability and USO eligibility as separate evidence layers; the downloadable fixed coverage archive cannot by itself establish affordable-decent-broadband or legal USO eligibility.

facts: Ofcom has not published a Fixed Performance Postcode file since July 2024
The revised collection supports robust average download-speed reporting down to local-authority level but not postcode level
Fixed coverage and fixed performance are distinct downloads and methodologies
official_source_candidates.guard: Do not derive or backfill postcode average speeds or performance from coverage percentages, provider maxima or higher-level averages.

facts: OS Open Linked Identifiers contains UPRN, USRN, TOID and GUID relationships
UDPRNs are not included because third-party intellectual property applies
The product covers Great Britain rather than the whole United Kingdom
official_source_candidates.guard: Treat UDPRN and UPRN as distinct namespaces; missing UDPRN evidence is expected and cannot be converted into missing UPRN, no-address or no-data conclusions.

facts: The eleven relationship packages are full supplies updated every six weeks
Each release follows shortly after the corresponding AddressBase Premium release
Individual ZIP sizes range from hundreds of megabytes to about 5-8 gigabytes
The uncompressed CSV join tables are intended for database loading and contain no geometry
official_source_candidates.guard: Use resumable streaming and database bulk loading with package hashes and resource budgets; do not use Excel or a GIS application as the validation path and do not assume identical publication timestamps across source and relationship products.

facts: There are exactly eleven named correlation-method packages
Each package is a full relationship supply with CSV, versions JSON, licence and description
Latest source-feature version information can differ from the versions used to form the original relationship
Confidence describes that version consistency and may be constant for some relationships
official_source_candidates.guard: Pin the correlation-method name, four-file manifest, relationship epoch and both source publication identities; never interpret confidence as probability, geometry accuracy or legal-boundary confidence.

facts: Application Cross Reference is record type 23 and links a UPRN to third-party identifiers
XREF_KEY is a mandatory 14-character primary key and UPRN is a mandatory 12-digit foreign key to BLPU
PRO_ORDER records the processing order used to create the supply
SOURCE values are explicitly not a closed code list and may be extended
official_source_candidates.guard: Enforce XREF_KEY uniqueness, BLPU referential integrity and deterministic PRO_ORDER handling while preserving unknown SOURCE values as unclassified extensions rather than rejecting or silently interpreting them.
Use these four values only for their documented Islands-specific roles; do not infer parcel ownership, current occupancy or a universal territory mapping from a cross-reference code alone.

facts: Title Descriptor documents eight estate-interest codes
It documents fifteen class-of-title codes including freehold, leasehold, scheme, commonhold, rentcharge and caution classes
A registered title has one title number and one class of title
A pending application can have a title number while estate interest and class are blank
official_source_candidates.guard: Validate exact documented enums and current-row uniqueness by Title Number; allow blank estate/class only for Pending and do not reduce all class codes to a binary freehold/leasehold label.

facts: The delivery uses LR_TENURE_FULL_MMM, LR_TENURE-COU-DD-MMM-YYYY and LR_TENURE_VALI_MMM naming
Full, change-only and validation files are published monthly from the second working day
The data can change more than once during a month but only the latest state is published
Change Indicator values are New, Changed and Deleted
official_source_candidates.guard: Require a dated full baseline, matching validation file and ordered COUs; preserve audit history while accepting that unpublished intra-month intermediate states cannot be reconstructed.

facts: National Polygon Service files published in a month contain data for the previous month
Title Number and UPRN Look Up has a complete file and validation file but no change-only file
Address and title associations can change several times during the source cycle while the published data shows only the last change
One title can legitimately associate with multiple UPRNs
official_source_candidates.guard: Label publication month separately from represented data month, reject invented Title-UPRN COUs or intermediate histories and preserve all proven title-to-UPRN edges.

facts: Index polygons may be the same size, larger or smaller than the title-plan extent
Footprint and artificial-footprint polygons can deliberately exceed individual title extents
Exaggerated extents can show narrow strips at a minimum display width
Former gridding practice can split one registration across multiple polygon identifiers
official_source_candidates.guard: Preserve representation type and one-to-many polygon structure; footprint, exaggerated or gridded geometry cannot be promoted to exact parcel extent or deduplicated solely by containment.
